summary: Configured node1 to boot persistently with `audit=1` and verified it after a full node restart. The running kernel has `audit=1`, kernel auditing reports enabled, and the system recovered healthy with zero failed units.
actions_performed: Added `audit=1` to all grubby-managed kernel boot entries.
Verified the boot ID changed from `180a78a0-8a84-45ff-82f1-cd734208a369` to `b15daf9f-f022-41b4-b930-f00f3798831d`.
Confirmed `/proc/cmdline` contains exactly one `audit=1`, `auditctl -s` reports `enabled 1`, and persistent boot entries retain the parameter.

evidence.requirement: Kernel boots with audit=1 and retains it across reboots
evidence.summary: All kernel boot entries were configured with `audit=1`; after reboot, the live kernel command line contains it and auditing reports enabled.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart and recovery sequence
evidence.summary: Captured healthy baseline and original boot ID, acknowledged the safe reboot, observed a changed boot ID, then confirmed running system state, zero failed units, active audit setting, and persistent configuration.
